reviewer_role: independent non-ledger Phase D gap auditor
scope: Source-bound read-only reassessment of every non-ledger critical and major finding in implementation_review_v2.json. operateur/internal/govar and article3/infra/postgres were deliberately excluded because a concurrent repair owned those paths. Archived Article 3 material was not used as evidence. The only reviewer-authored file is this report.

summary.reason: The four prior non-ledger critical counterexamples have source-level repairs under an explicit trusted-gateway boundary, and selected-route actuation passed a real Envoy integration test. Release is still blocked by mutable workload identity assignment, incomplete enforcement coverage/evidence, excessive admission RBAC, absent request-level approval consumption, absent trusted cap/pricing/calibration producers, absent workers and GOV-AR observability, absent combined PostgreSQL/Envoy E0 evidence, and an unevidenced upgrade path. Streaming now fails closed and is an explicitly bounded unsupported feature rather than a demonstrated safety bypass.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: operateur/cmd/gov-ar-admission/main.go:68-74 gives projected workload tokens ADMISSION_ONLY and signed gateway requests GATEWAY roles; handleDispatch, handleSettle, and handleCancel reject non-gateway roles at lines 300-303, 333-336, and 370-373. The exact zero-token forgery is rejected before the backend in main_test.go:102-119. The master signing secret is mounted only in the admission deployment, while the injected workload receives only a Pod-bound projected token.
prior_finding_reassessment.boundary: Provider usage is authoritative only because the mTLS-authenticated Envoy process is in the trusted computing base. Compromise of that gateway is outside this repair's non-Byzantine gateway assumption.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: main.go:550-621 resolves the live Pod and ServiceAccount, then consumes a Ready AIWorkloadBinding whose status pins the ServiceAccount and policy UID/generation. main.go:655-661 rejects body disagreement; main_test.go:240-283 covers stale policy evidence and conflicting Pod tenant metadata. The manager ClusterRole grants no AIWorkloadBinding spec write. However aiworkloadbinding_types.go:28-85 describes TenantID as immutable without any oldSelf CEL/update validator; its only root CEL rule enforces name equality. A privileged writer can mutate tenant/team/application/policy assignment in place while retaining the binding UID.

govarextproc/server.go:199-214 resolves a server-owned typed route before claim; lines 238-292 rewrite OpenAI/Anthropic model bodies and Azure/Google deployment paths; lines 404-416 overwrite cluster, authority, path, content length and model headers while clearing Envoy's route cache. The chart uses cluster_header and host_rewrite_header. The opt-in real Envoy test observed the admission-selected backend, authority and rewritten provider model and passed in this review. The remaining absence of a PostgreSQL-backed Kind E0 is tracked separately as POSTFIX-M11.

podinjector/injector.go:204-220 prevents Pod opt-out from overriding namespace-required enforcement and marks native-gateway use. sidecarproxy/proxy.go rejects governed CONNECT, unknown governed shapes, direct governed dispatch, streaming, and bodies over 1 MiB. gov-ar-networkpolicy.yaml selects every Pod in one configured dedicated namespace and permits only DNS and the selected gateway. Production chart rendering fails without that policy and namespace. No test actually applies a NetworkPolicy in Kind and proves raw sockets, opt-out Pods, omitted provider paths, and forged gateway labels cannot escape; one Helm release configures only one governedNamespace.

airoutingpolicy_types.go:111-166 now types registry reference, fixed size, opportunity/weight hashes, freeze time, alpha and allocation and the generated CRDs contain these fields. No non-ledger CohortRegistry API, immutable artifact resolver, producer/controller, or pre-outcome freeze validation exists. The typed fields remain user assertions; no source inspected here proves membership was fixed before outcomes.
prior_finding_reassessment.required_repair: Add an immutable operator-owned cohort artifact/registry and producer, bind policy status to its UID/version/hash and freeze time, and test mutation/replay/future-outcome rejection.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: The admission API and ext_proc payload have no approval reference or approval token. Existing AIChangeRequest is a long-lived model reroute workflow only: aichangerequest_types.go has no request/reservation/workload/policy-version binding, and aichangerequest_controller.go actuates an AIGatewayRoute rather than consuming a one-shot admission approval. REQUIRE_APPROVAL therefore has no version-bound, expiring, non-replay path back to admission.
prior_finding_reassessment.required_repair: Implement a request-level approval object/token bound to request fingerprint, tenant/workload, policy/pricing generations, route, expiry and one effective consumption; test approval replay and stale-version denial.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: Rollover, origin/current windows, carried debt, guards and audit credit are ledger concerns in the explicitly excluded active paths. No conclusion was inferred from filenames or concurrent edits.

aiprovider_types.go:24-95 adds exact resource.Quantity prices, version, observation time, completeness and named billable categories; aimodel_types.go:81-130 adds typed output-cap and latency observations. However aiprovider_controller.go only marks provider Ready and does not verify source/version/completeness. aimodel_controller.go does not populate GOVAR.VerifiedOutputCap or latency. Base and extra prices have no explicit nonnegative validation, and status cap evidence has no capability-introspection producer. Thus a user can assert complete pricing/cap evidence without an independently observed source.
prior_finding_reassessment.required_repair: Add source-specific capability and complete billable-category introspection with immutable source version, nonnegative schema checks, status ownership and freshness/future bounds; prove fail-closed behavior when any category/cap is unknown.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: airoutingpolicy_types.go:67-204 and generated CRDs type calibration artifact/version/support/age, detector/threshold/fallback and visible drift status. Repository search in the reviewed non-ledger controllers finds no selected-feedback calibration updater, artifact validator, detector, conservative-mode status producer or revalidation controller. AIRoutingPolicyReconciler leaves GOVAR status unproduced.
prior_finding_reassessment.required_repair: Implement and test a selected-feedback calibration store/updater, immutable artifact verification, frozen detector, conservative fallback transition, support loss, and revalidation before calibrated risk resumes.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: Typed GOV-AR route, routability, cap, latency, reservation, calibration, drift, cohort, risk, pricing version/completeness and billable-category fields now exist in Go types and matching chart/config CRDs. CRD byte hashes match between chart and config for AIModel, AIProvider, AIRoutingPolicy and AIWorkloadBinding. Missing producers and semantic validation are retained under POSTFIX-M1, M4 and M5 rather than silently treating declarations as evidence.

cmd/gov-ar-admission/main.go starts the HTTP and gRPC servers but no background dispatcher, expiry scanner, unresolved-usage resolver, correction/finality reconciler, calibration updater or rollover scheduler. ext_proc performs synchronous claim/deliver/settle and leaves oversized/missing usage unresolved. Any concurrent worker code inside excluded ledger files was not reviewed and cannot establish deployed orchestration without main/chart wiring.
prior_finding_reassessment.required_repair: Wire durable workers with bounded leases/retries and health metrics into the production service, then test crash/restart, duplicate workers, poison events and reconciliation convergence against PostgreSQL.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: cmd/gov-ar-admission/main.go:168 exposes promhttp.Handler, but no GOV-AR counter, histogram or liability gauge is registered in the service or ext_proc; no OpenTelemetry propagation/spans or immutable structured transition audit is emitted. Existing operator metrics are unrelated controller metrics and cannot reconstruct reserve/dispatch/settle behavior.
prior_finding_reassessment.required_repair: Add bounded-cardinality decision/latency/transition/liability/retry/unresolved metrics, trace propagation and spans, and redacted immutable audit records linked by request/attempt/trace IDs.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: Both ext_proc and sidecar cap request/response bodies at 1 MiB. ext_proc rejects stream=true before reservation dispatch and the governed sidecar rejects streaming/direct dispatch; README documents the boundary. This removes the prior unbounded-buffer safety defect but does not implement SSE/disconnect/partial-usage settlement.
prior_finding_reassessment.scope_requirement: Keep streaming explicitly out of the measured production claim and manuscript scope or implement authoritative streaming semantics before claiming general LLM-gateway support.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: New CRD fields are optional and existing v1alpha1 objects remain structurally readable; generated chart and config CRDs match. No Helm pre-upgrade migration Job/hook, schema-version readiness contract, database backup/restore step, or clean upgrade/rollback test exists. Database conversion details are in excluded active paths and were not inferred.
prior_finding_reassessment.required_repair: After the ledger migration stabilizes, provide a versioned, checksum-bound migration plus reconciliation proof and test clean install, supported old-version upgrade, failed-migration rollback and application rollback with real PostgreSQL.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: real_envoy_test.go proves a real pinned Envoy routes to the selected backend, but its admission service is an httptest fake and no PostgreSQL is involved. test/e2e/e2e_test.go remains a controller-manager smoke test. run_test_matrix.sh --internal-gateway-e2e runs package tests plus that smoke test; it does not deploy PostgreSQL, gov-ar-admission, mTLS Envoy and backend in Kind or verify reserve-to-settle ledger state. The chart supplies only an optional Envoy ConfigMap, not a deployable gateway/certificate/backend E0 stack; its example backend defaults to port 443 without an upstream TLS transport socket.
prior_finding_reassessment.required_repair: Create and run a source-hash-bound Kind E0 that deploys PostgreSQL, admission, mTLS Envoy, typed models/routes and a usage backend, observes the selected backend, then queries exact ledger/outbox state for all decision and missing-usage paths.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: server.go:147-165 requires a verified allowlisted gateway certificate; lines 361-390 require a single SANITIZE_SET-style record whose By equals that authenticated gateway URI and whose Hash decodes to 32 bytes, then resolve the URI through live operator-owned binding state. README.md explicitly states the gateway credential holder can author XFCC and is part of the TCB. Production NetworkPolicy restricts ext_proc ingress to the gateway selector while mTLS remains the cryptographic control.
prior_finding_reassessment.boundary: This is trusted-proxy identity, not end-to-end cryptographic proof of the downstream certificate at ext_proc. The release must retain the narrow secret mount, SANITIZE_SET configuration and gateway-only network/RBAC conformance checks.

prior_finding_reassessment.evidence: Dockerfile.gov-ar-admission pins readable Go 1.21 and distroless tags to immutable OCI index digests, uses -trimpath and -buildvcs=false, and build_base_images.json records linux/amd64 child manifests and tool output hashes. A focused build and nonroot entrypoint inspection passed. The final clean release image still requires its own immutable digest evidence.

new_major_findings.summary: The authoritative financial/governance binding is mutable despite being documented immutable.
new_major_findings.rationale: AIWorkloadBinding has no oldSelf rule or validating webhook preventing changes to tenant, team, application, policies, sensitivity, zones or ServiceAccount assignment. Read-only application RBAC prevents the original unprivileged cross-tenant counterexample, but an accidental or compromised authorized writer can change identity in place while active liabilities still reference the old assignment.
new_major_findings.required_repair: Make financial identity and resolved principal fields update-immutable, or implement an explicit versioned replacement/migration protocol that refuses change while exposure exists; add API-server validation and active-liability tests.

new_major_findings.summary: Direct-egress prevention is limited to one configured namespace and is not demonstrated in Kind.
new_major_findings.rationale: The NetworkPolicy design is fail-closed for Pods in its dedicated namespace, but AIWorkloadBinding can exist in any namespace and nothing binds every Ready gateway-required binding to a selected/enforced namespace. No real CNI test attempts direct TCP/HTTPS, Pod opt-out, target/path variation, forged gateway label, or NetworkPolicy deletion/failure.
new_major_findings.required_repair: Define enforceable namespace coverage for every binding and run bypass-negative Kind tests with a NetworkPolicy-capable CNI; make missing/deleted policy visible and admission-unready.

new_major_findings.summary: gov-ar-admission runs with the broad controller-manager ServiceAccount and ClusterRole.
new_major_findings.rationale: gov-ar-admission-deployment.yaml uses operator.serviceAccountName. That ClusterRole can create/update/delete budget policies, routing policies, models, providers and change requests and patch gateway routes, far beyond admission's read, TokenReview and status-free needs. Compromise of the synchronous gateway service therefore expands into policy/catalog/data-plane mutation.
new_major_findings.required_repair: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount, Role/ClusterRole and binding granting only required get/list/watch on Pods, ServiceAccounts, bindings/policies/catalog plus TokenReview create; prove forbidden writes with SelfSubjectAccessReview or impersonated RBAC tests.

minor_findings.summary: SSE/streaming requests are safely rejected; disconnect, partial usage and terminal settlement are not implemented.
minor_findings.disposition: Document and preserve this scope limit unless streaming becomes a measured claim.

minor_findings.summary: The admission ingress NetworkPolicy allows only ext_proc port 9002 while liveness/readiness use HTTP 8084. Node-originated probe handling differs by CNI and is not tested.
minor_findings.disposition: Exercise probes under the chosen Kind CNI and explicitly allow only the required node/probe source if necessary without exposing the internal HTTP API to workloads.
